outcome: Rate of pain assessment at triage
cohort: Pediatric patients under 18 years of age presenting to five community emergency departments with pain or injury between February 2018 and May 2018 were included.
finding: Younger age, higher acuity, and presenting with head or neck pain independently predicted pain assessment at triage, while children aged 3-5 years and those with lower extremity pain were more likely to receive analgesia.
